title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：poverty　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 poverty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the father ① fought the poverty that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the fighting was the whole of the month. The ② poverty, meaning the need itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; poverty, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of poverty in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ poverty at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Poverty, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the poverty was the whole of the matter, meaning the hardship and not the need. The ⑥ poverty, meaning the hardship and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; poverty, he said, is either something you fight or the only word that means both need and a hardship. He said the hardship is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ poverty had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ poverty of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; poverty, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ poverty I remember is the poverty recorded in the letter, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. ⑩ Poverty, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all poverty, she said, is a hardship that has agreed to look like need. She said the hardship was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 贫穷；贫困（指老屋里每一样旁边的那一样）
B. n. 贫穷；贫困（指那分贫穷本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：fight the poverty 抗这一分贫穷
D. n. 贫穷；贫困（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 贫穷之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的贫穷之事）
F. n. 贫穷；贫困（指家书里写到、被记载的那一分）
G. n. 贫穷、苦境（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 苦境（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fought the poverty that no neighbour in the house would have recorded
The poverty, meaning the need itself and not the chair
Every sort of poverty in that house
the poverty at the far door
the poverty was the whole of the matter
the poverty had become a line in a letter
The poverty of the whole thing

answers.why: fight the poverty 意为“抗这一分贫穷”，1973 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯记载的一分贫穷做了一遍。
poverty 意为“贫穷；贫困”，指那分贫穷本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
poverty 意为“贫穷；贫困”，指老屋里每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
poverty 意为“贫穷；贫困”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
poverty 意为“贫穷、苦境”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分苦境就是那件事的全部。
poverty 意为“苦境”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分贫穷，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
poverty 意为“贫穷；贫困”，指家书里写到、被记载的那一分，到 1978 年这一分成了家书里的一行。
poverty 意为“贫穷之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的贫穷之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
poverty 意为“贫穷；贫困”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一分，1980 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一分。
poverty 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，贫穷是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的贫穷。
